clips.title: The story
paras: At South Gate Outpost, Mountaineer Barleybrew watches the pass from Dun Morogh toward Loch Modan. He relies on dwarven brews to help sentries endure the cold.

Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew watches the snowy road to Loch Modan from South Gate Outpost. He is part of Ironforge's border watch. Like other mountaineers in Dun Morogh's bitter winds, he values the strength of fine dwarven drink. His name links him to the renowned Barleybrew clan. He also helps send potent Shimmer Stout to fellow watchmen who need warmth and stamina during long shifts in the mountain passes.
